response.rationale: “Detik” is the ordinary Indonesian term for a second, while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “saat” for the same unit. The contrast is useful but represents preference, not exclusive ownership.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian Malay may use “detik” for the same sense in some contexts, so the national preference should not be taught as exclusive.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Detik” is also understood and used in Malaysian Malay, but “saat” remains a credible ordinary Malaysian preference for the time unit; this does not erase the useful contrast.
